meta.title: Fit Compas — train with a plan, not a guess
meta.description: A video library of exercises, workouts built down to the last round, and a program written for you by a coach. All in one place, on your phone.

hero.title: Train with a plan,
hero.subtitle: Every exercise has a video. Every workout has rounds, rest and tempo. Every program is written by a coach for you — not generated from a template.

features.title: Everything a coach needs to guide you, and you need to execute
features.subtitle: No scattered PDFs, no clips buried in group chats, no guessing how many sets to do.

items.title: A video for every exercise
items.body: Shot from the angle that shows what you're doing wrong. No hunting on YouTube, no three conflicting explanations.

items.title: Workouts built to the detail
items.body: Warmup, main work by groups and rounds, cooldown. Rest between exercises, between rounds and between groups — all written in.

items.title: A program written by a human
items.body: Your coach assigns a weekly plan by day. They see what you did, what you skipped, and adjust as you go.

items.title: A timer that runs the session
items.body: Rounds, rest and transitions advance on their own. The screen stays awake and the phone buzzes on every change — no touching it with sweaty hands.

items.title: Progress you can actually see
items.body: Weights, measurements, photos and your streak. Charts show the trend, not just the last number you typed.

items.title: Built for the phone
items.body: Designed first for the screen you hold in the gym, and only then for desktop. Not the other way around.

how.title: Three steps to your first session

steps.title: Create an account
steps.body: Tell us your goal, your level and the equipment you have. Takes a minute.

steps.title: Get your plan
steps.body: A coach assigns a program matched to where you are now, with workouts laid out day by day.

steps.title: Train and log it
steps.body: Open the day, follow the video and the timer, log your weights. Your coach sees the result and adjusts what comes next.

pricing.title: One subscription, the whole library
pricing.subtitle: No hidden tiers, no paying per program.

plans.name: Coached
features: A program written for you personally
Weekly schedule laid out by day

items.a: No. Exercises are tagged by equipment, so your program is built around what you actually have — from a full gym to bodyweight in a bedroom.
Yes, any time from your account. You keep access until the end of the period you paid for, no support conversation required.
Every exercise has a video and a difficulty level, and your program starts at your level. Your coach moves it as you progress.

items.q: Does it work on a phone?
items.a: Yes, and it was designed for the phone first. Mobile apps for Android and iPhone are coming.

items.q: I have an injury or health condition.
items.a: You note it on your profile when you sign up. Your coach sees it before writing your program and works around the movements involved.

cta.title: Your next session could start in five minutes
cta.subtitle: Create an account, tell us where you are now, and get a plan that makes sense.

footer.tagline: Train with a plan, not a guess.

aside.title: Your plan is waiting
aside.body: Log in and pick up where you left off.
aside.point2: Training laid out day by day

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Get back to training.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.subtitle: A minute of setup, then your first session.
signup.terms: By creating an account you accept the terms of service and privacy policy.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We'll email you a link. Takes five minutes.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. Check your spam folder too.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Set a new password and you're done.

checkEmail.title: Confirm your email
checkEmail.body: We sent you a confirmation link. Open it and your account is live.
checkEmail.hint: Didn't arrive? Check spam before trying again.

errors.not_configured: The database isn't connected yet. This is in progress — try again in a few minutes.
errors.email_not_confirmed: This account isn't confirmed yet. Open the link in your email.
errors.email_taken: An account with this address already exists.
errors.weak_password: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.invalid_link: That link expired or was already used. Request a new one.

dashboard.placeholderBody: Today's workout, the week's schedule and your progress. We're building in order — the exercise library is next.
dashboard.noProfile: The account exists but no profile row was created. Run the profiles table and trigger SQL.

home.title: Hello
home.subtitle: Everything a client sees is built and edited from here — from equipment names to a finished program.
home.configBody: Equipment, muscle groups, goals, activities and health conditions. These are the lists the whole library filters on, so they are worth settling before the first exercise goes in.
home.soonBody: Exercises, workouts, programs and clients are next. Menu entries marked “soon” have no screen yet — they show up as they are finished.

config.title: Configuration
config.subtitle: Five vocabularies used to tag and filter exercises, workouts and programs. Names change whenever you like; the slug stays put so existing tags keep working.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.description: Everything a movement is done with, from bodyweight to a treadmill. Each machine also declares which numbers the workout builder asks for.

muscle_groups.title: Muscle groups
muscle_groups.description: Groups and subgroups, one level deep: Back → Lats. The library filters on these and workout coverage is measured from them.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: Why someone trains: mass, strength, fat loss, mobility. The same list is offered to a client at sign-up and to an exercise when tagging.

activities.title: Activities
activities.description: The training modality — strength, cardio, pilates, warm-up. Decides how exercises group in the library.

health_issues.title: Health conditions
health_issues.description: What a program has to work around: back pain, a knee injury, pregnancy. Drives warnings and exercise selection.

editor.empty: The list is empty. Add the first item.
editor.nameHint: Serbian is required — it is what the display falls back to when a translation is missing.
editor.slugHint: Leave empty to derive it from the name.
editor.slugLocked: The slug never changes — links and saved filters point at it.
editor.metricsHint: What this machine asks for in the workout builder. A treadmill wants incline and speed, a barbell only weight.
editor.reorderOff: Order can only change while the full list is showing — no search, no filter.

errors.not_admin: You are not allowed to make this change.
errors.invalid_slug: A slug may only contain lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
errors.slug_taken: That slug is already used in this list.
errors.invalid_parent: That parent is not valid — the tree stays one level deep.
